`final class BinaryMsdfSource`<br/>
**Extends:** [`MsdfSource`](/reference/text/msdfsource/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.msdf.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BinaryMsdfSource.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/msdf/source/BinaryMsdfSource.java)

Reads a face from a .msdf file made by the msdf tool of JOID, with no generation at load time.

## Description

Ship `.msdf` files to skip the generation of the first load.
The read fails with `IOException` when the file does not start with `JOIDMSDF` or was written in another format version of the tool.
